actionReview.AD01: Disabled automatic notifications require silent/notifications_disabled; factual contradicted branch must actually be reached.
actionReview.AD02: Enabled literal selected topic on a current qualifying contradiction permits notify/selected_topic_contradiction; abstention is not a notification-branch pass.
actionReview.AD03: Supported automatic result stays silent/automatic_noncontradiction even with selected topic.
actionReview.AD04: Contradiction without selected topic stays silent/insufficient_priority only if recorded numeric practical consequence is below0.8; missing/high priority must be separately reported.
actionReview.AD05: Private personal input skips with silent/private_or_personal, zero Exa and no admitted public span; no factual result or cached:false flag is expected.
actionReview.AD06: Muted manual check may complete its factual result but must present silent/muted, rather than being rejected as a check.

isolationReview: Each sample runs through a new runLiveCampaign invocation, which constructs a new provider budget/server/session/cache. The catalog is not run as one shared-session campaign.
Repeated BD10 scenarios therefore remain cold diagnostic repeats, not new independent factual accuracy samples.
Conservative spacing from preceding automatic completion ensures at least4100ms between automatic dispatches; spacing is recorded separately and included in cohort wall time.
budgetReview: Remaining provider-call, charged-token and request-byte allowances subtract all completed reports; elapsed wall includes authentication/startup/spacing.
No exhausted dimension is rounded upward. Unknown finalized Jev usage, local/transport failure, incomplete campaign, overrun or wall exhaustion stops subsequent scenarios.
Within each invocation the existing observed provider dispatcher reserves and records attempts; cumulative wrapper preserves original reports and partial costs.
The wrapper verifies clean exact source commit/hash and predeclared manifest hash before live execution; live mode is explicit and fresh output/journal paths are exclusive.
Source-freeze arguments and final full check remain prerequisites; this review made no execution approval outside the root-approved bounds.

limitations: Known public outcome labels informed diagnostic case selection; no blindness or general action accuracy claim.
No scenario enlarges the broader-development or independent release factual denominator.
Verdict-dependent silence is inconclusive if the run abstains or fails operationally; source-groundtruth labels do not force retrieved evidence to qualify.
Selected live citations need a separate actual-content/source-scope review; prior source records do not pre-verify new outputs.
